props.name: underline
props.description: `always` for links inside running text, where colour alone would not mark them; `hover` for navigation lists.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab: adds `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, an arrow glyph, and the words below for screen readers. Defaults to true when `target="_blank"` is passed.

props.name: newTabLabel
props.description: Hidden text read after an external link’s name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Renders plain text marked as a disabled link — nothing to click, nothing to tab to.

props.name: as
props.description: Render as another component — usually a router link: `as={Link} to="/billing"`.
